$comment: Completion bar for #18: the lkvmedia:// protocol handler passed `?path=` straight to net.fetch(file://) with no allowlist/type/directory check, and the scheme was registered with bypassCSP/supportFetchAPI/corsEnabled — so renderer code (or a remote page via the missing window guards) could read any file on disk (keys, JSON, ~/.ssh/id_rsa). Fix: serve only files registered under opaque ids (media-protocol.ts), allowlist media extensions, reject directories and non-media files, drop bypassCSP/corsEnabled/supportFetchAPI, and set correct MIME types. Criteria 1-2 fail before the change (bypassCSP was present; resolveMediaFile did not exist); 3 covers the registry unit tests; 4-5 guard typecheck, build, and the rest of the suite.
